page.layout: One printed page. Full-width heading at top: running head "EMBLEMA" above a two-line title "OPES ET GLORIA HVIVS / mundi vanitas". main_text.l: OPES ET GLORIA HVIVS mundi vanitas.

l.i: Sis licet excelsi sublatus ad æthera cœli,

page.notes: The woodcut shows a naked man standing on a table-like stand, holding a balance pan in each hand, a large globe above his head with a flaming hourglass or lamp on top, a bird (peacock-like) at left, and a book or cloth at the foot. No text inside the picture. The verse line 1 reads "fugacior umbra" with "umbra" partly damaged; line 2 "Decussis cristis" is likely a printing error for "Decussis" / "cristis" and is kept as printed. The catchword "rerum" is underlined in the print. The heading "EMBLEMA" is a running head.
